name: Hearth sausage
summary: Thái hearth sausage. Báo Sơn La, on 15 May 2025, says a Chiềng Cơi workshop cuts buffalo, beef, or pork along the grain, seasons it with mắc khén, garlic, ginger, and chili, marinates it 1–2 hours, and smokes it about 6–8 hours to a dark brown. The sausage is named as its own product. In 2023 the provincial investment and tourism center helped register the name, and the province listed it as a rural-industry product. A price was not printed.
origin: Báo Sơn La, 15 May 2025. The workshop is tổ 3, phường Chiềng Cơi.
texture: After about 6–8 hours the meat is firm and chewy, and the natural sweetness is still there.
taste: The workshop account says fragrant, mildly hot, smoky, with the wood, and still sweet.
howToEat: As the sausage, or carry it. A price and a shop hour are Check on arrival.
where: Phường Chiềng Cơi. The article also says the meat is chosen at chợ 7/11, phường Quyết Thắng. No stall is a pick.
seoTitle: Lap xuong gac bep in Son La — hearth sausage
seoDescription: Lạp xưởng gác bếp in Sơn La. Báo Sơn La prints a 1–2 hour marinade and about 6–8 hours of smoke in Chiềng Cơi. A price is Check on arrival.
